delivery.outcome: Split packages/coru/src/coru/cli.py (code2llm God Module: 180 top-level functions, 3 classes; detector threshold f_count > 40) into six responsibility modules plus the existing cli_terminal.py, keeping coru.cli as the stable facade. cli.py keeps only the command/dispatch surface (_cmd_* helpers, _dispatch_*, main; 23 top-level functions, 3 dataclasses) and re-imports every moved name so `from coru.cli import X` and `monkeypatch.setattr(coru_cli, "X", ...)` keep working for every pre-split name. New modules: cli_startup.py (project/log/startup/interactive/tool-bootstrap helpers, 34 fns), cli_daemon.py (lane/daemon resolution and lane env plumbing, 28 fns, owns the env-derived _KORU_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S constant used as a def-time default argument), cli_doctor.py (lane status payload, repair, doctor, 27 fns), cli_readiness.py (auto readiness/ownership gates, 21 fns), cli_diagnose.py (daemon start, runtime diagnostics, LLM prompt rewrite, 18 fns), cli_plan.py (plan chain build/execute and chat loop, 21 fns). cli_terminal.py gains _print_terminal_context; the seven terminal shims already duplicated byte-identically in cli_terminal.py are deleted from cli.py in favor of facade imports. Functions move verbatim; moved functions resolve cross-module and patch-target names through `from coru.cli import ...` at call time (the existing cli_calibration.py pattern) so test patching of coru.cli attributes is preserved exactly.

Splitting any other module flagged by code2llm (e.g. src/koru/integrations/vdisplay_client.py)

architecture.decision: Move functions verbatim (same private names) into six new responsibility modules and re-export them from the coru.cli facade (import-time re-exports for the facade surface itself). Unlike the koru.queue.context split (ticket-221, no patch targets), packages/coru/tests/test_coru_cli.py monkeypatches 67 distinct coru.cli attributes (e.g. _diagnose_lane, _default_lane, _run_koru_lane, _terminal_shell_context), and repair/runtime.py plus cli_calibration.py import private helpers from coru.cli at call time. Therefore every moved function that references a cli-namespace name outside its own destination module, and every reference to a test patch target regardless of location, resolves that name through a function-local `from coru.cli import ...` (call-time facade late binding, the pattern already used throughout cli_calibration.py). Same-module references to non-patch-target helpers stay direct. The three dataclasses (Plan, SessionContext, AutoReadiness) and the facade-only constants stay in cli.py; the single exception is _KORU_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S, which moves to cli_daemon.py because two moved functions use it as a def-time default argument and a def-time coru.cli import would be circular. The seven _terminal_*/IDE shim functions at cli.py:696-740 are byte-identical duplicates of cli_terminal.py definitions, so they are deleted, not moved; cli.py re-imports them from cli_terminal.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single 3464-line cli.py.
